Which physical property is used to measure temperature in a liquid-in-glass thermometer?
A
the length of the thermometer
B
the thickness of the glass bulb
C
the volume of the glass bulb
D
the volume of the liquid

options.label: B
options.text: the thickness of the glass bulb

options.label: C
options.text: the volume of the glass bulb
